override_policy: Project-local memory may add, narrow, or override archetype guidance after plugin defaults without mutating plugin files.

archetypes.label: WordPress/content website
discriminating_questions: What content model, page templates, and editorial workflow are needed?
What theme, block, plugin, hosting, SEO, redirects, forms, analytics, accessibility, and performance constraints apply?
likely_design_needs: Brand expression, typography, imagery, content hierarchy, reusable blocks, responsive page layouts, accessibility contrast, and editorial component consistency.
validation_baseline: Backup and deploy verification for live sidecars

archetypes.label: Web application/SaaS
discriminating_questions: What user roles, core workflows, data model, authentication, authorization, API contracts, state, environments, billing, observability, acceptance criteria, and deployment target apply?
likely_design_needs: Application information architecture, task density, component system, dashboard and table patterns, form states, empty/error/loading states, responsive behavior, and accessibility floor.
validation_baseline: Smoke or e2e tests for critical flows

archetypes.label: CLI/library
discriminating_questions: What public API, compatibility shim, command surface, JSON output contract, package target, supported runtime, documentation generation, and migration policy apply?
likely_design_needs: Documentation hierarchy, examples, terminal output clarity, and error-message style.

archetypes.label: Mobile/desktop app
discriminating_questions: What target platforms, native or web stack, device capabilities, offline behavior, notifications, permissions, app-store or notarization path, accessibility, and telemetry rules apply?
likely_design_needs: Platform conventions, navigation, responsive or adaptive layout, touch and keyboard input, native component patterns, iconography, and motion.
validation_baseline: Build and test for target platform
Packaging and signing checks when applicable

archetypes.label: Data/automation workflow
discriminating_questions: What data sources, schemas, schedules, transformations, idempotency, retry behavior, observability, error handling, storage, and manual review points apply?
likely_design_needs: Operator dashboard, logs, reports, status tables, alert presentation, and artifact readability.

archetypes.label: Clinical/regulated workspace
discriminating_questions: What regulated data type, privacy boundary, local-only requirement, operation context, audit logging, deidentification, retention, access control, and synthetic test strategy apply?
likely_design_needs: Conservative workflow UI, clear status labels, audit evidence tables, accessible review surfaces, and no real PHI in examples or screenshots.

archetypes.label: Infrastructure/devops tooling
discriminating_questions: What target environment, provisioning tool, secrets model, deployment topology, rollback, observability, access boundary, blast radius, and cost constraints apply?
likely_design_needs: Runbooks, topology diagrams, status dashboards, and alert or incident views.

mixed_project_policy.primary_profile: Select one primary archetype for orchestration, top-level intake, queue shape, and milestone framing.
mixed_project_policy.secondary_profiles: Attach other applicable archetypes as scoped subprofiles or slices with their own targeted questions, validation baselines, high-risk surfaces, and slice patterns.
mixed_project_policy.conflict_policy: Conflicts stop only affected slices and dependents unless they change the whole project boundary, shared architecture, safety boundary, plugin-core behavior, PHI/privacy boundary, public API compatibility, or all remaining work.
